# Recreation Prompt

Create a mobile-first portrait browser game titled **Haddonfield Last Porch Watch**. Preserve the mechanics of a tap/click survival management loop: the player taps idle room/house cards to assign limited workers, progress bars complete after a short timed cycle, quota progress and currency are awarded, unattended cards accumulate danger, danger overflow causes failure, quota completion opens an upgrade shop, and restart/menu flows are available.

Theme the world as: Halloween slasher survival. A Halloween slasher survival game with Michael Myers stalking, suburban autumn dread, slow unstoppable pursuit, silent terror, masked menace, and classic seasonal horror tension with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

Use a procedural moonlit suburban street, porch-window tiles, a pale masked slasher silhouette, pumpkin orange/blood red/bone palette, readable portrait HUD, and touch-friendly controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source was a canvas-based survival management game. The player tapped idle containment rooms to assign limited workers, completed a short work cycle for quota/progress and currency, watched stress rise in unattended rooms, reached a quota to open an upgrade screen, and lost if any room stress filled.

## Protected mechanics
- Tap/click an idle playfield tile to start a timed work/rescue cycle.
- Only a limited number of workers/babysitters can be active at once.
- Unattended tiles accumulate danger over time; active tiles reduce danger and advance progress.
- Completing a cycle grants quota progress and spendable currency.
- Meeting the quota ends the active round and opens upgrades.
- Danger overflow triggers game over with restart/menu paths.

## Rebuilt target
Halloween slasher survival. A Halloween slasher survival game with Michael Myers stalking, suburban autumn dread, slow unstoppable pursuit, silent terror, masked menace, and classic seasonal horror tension with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The new surface reinterprets rooms as Haddonfield houses, stress as dread, energy as locks, credits as candy, workers as babysitters, and upgrades as survival preparations. Mechanics are preserved while scene, HUD, focal identity, background, and copy are rebuilt.
